note: Private. Proof map and valuation for settlement only. Never attach, quote, or paraphrase in anything defense counsel sees. Damages lines carrying amount 0 are placeholders, not values. No walk-away is set; the guard refuses every number until one is.

elements.element: Employment relationship: an accepted conditional offer for a specific Tracy warehouse requisition
elements.note: Same-day sequence: offer 3:47 p.m., background authorization ~4:22 p.m., drug order 4:30 p.m., 'congratulations on accepting' 5:31 p.m.

elements.element: Best Buy denied, withdrew, or failed to finalize the accepted employment
elements.note: Pleaded as cessation of contact with no stated reason. No pre-adverse or adverse-action letter in the file. Testimony plus absence of records; Best Buy's decision records are needed.

elements.element: Information disclosed pursuant to § 290.46 was used in the decision
elements.note: Information and belief only. This is the Lerma-territory gap (memo Rule 11): without a registry-source line the claim prices near nuisance.

elements.element: Registry information was a substantial factor in the decision
elements.note: Depends on the report and Best Buy's adjudication notes.

elements.element: Actual damages measurable from documented pay terms
elements.note: Rate ($22.60) is documented; weekly hours, start date, and duration are not.

defenses.name: Motion to compel arbitration (Arbitration Policy; Candidate Offer Response)
open_questions: Does Best Buy's audit trail tie the Offer Response to credentials only Plaintiff controlled?
Was the Mar. 15, 2016 policy the version in effect in Oct. 2023?
What do the brennforbi@gmail.com Candidate Zone emails show? The complaint pleads acceptance of the offer through the Candidate Zone, which limits any sworn denial.
defenses.note: Moves the forum; does not reduce damages lines. Its value effect is leverage and timing, not math.

defenses.name: Decision rested on lawfully obtained conviction information or another non-§ 290.46 reason
open_questions: What did the First Advantage report contain and source?
What did Best Buy's adjudication record say?

defenses.name: One-year limitations for statutory penalties (Code Civ. Proc. § 340(a)) as to penalty-type relief
open_questions: Whether § 340(a) reaches the § 290.46(j)(4)(A) additional amount or exemplary relief, versus the three-year period of § 338(a) for statutory liability [UNVERIFIED: run citation-verify before relying on either]

defenses.name: Interim earnings and failure to mitigate since Oct. 2023
open_questions: Plaintiff's earnings from Oct. 2023 to date, by period

defenses.name: Offer was expressly contingent on favorable background results; employment at will
open_questions: Answered on the law if § 290.46 bars the registry use itself; depends on registry-use proof

damages.label: Lost wages: $22.60 × [weekly hours: UNKNOWN] × [supportable period: UNKNOWN], less interim earnings. PLACEHOLDER
damages.why_p: Rate documented; hours and duration undocumented; mitigation offset unknown. Set the amount only from a document or truthful recollection.

damages.label: § 290.46(j)(4)(A) additional amount: at least $250, up to treble actual damages (memo § 8). Floor shown; treble depends on back_pay
damages.why_p: Rides entirely on registry-use proof, which is information-and-belief today.

damages.label: § 290.46(j)(4)(A) exemplary damages (pleaded instead of the civil penalty; memo § 8 reads the exemplary-or-penalty relief as capped at $25,000; confirm statute text)
damages.why_p: Needs registry use plus the culpability showing; nothing in hand shows Best Buy knew the use was barred.

damages.label: Emotional distress: Plaintiff's figure to set. PLACEHOLDER

positions.opening_basis: None. Memo § 4 has no Best Buy row and § 4A has no defense wage math (Plaintiff filed in federal court; no removal). Engine must run on Plaintiff's own documented hours once found.

trigger.label: First Advantage report or Best Buy records tie the decision to a California-registry source (memo Rule 11)
trigger.note: Not met. Until it is, value sits near the nuisance band regardless of forum.

repricing_events.if_favorable: No signing timestamp, IP, or credential control shown: formation fight is real; raise leverage, mediation before the motion.
repricing_events.if_unfavorable: Clean trail and competent HR declaration: assume arbitration; leverage is Best Buy's arbitrator-fee burden.

repricing_events.if_favorable: Weekly hours documented: fill back_pay and run the § 4A engine on Plaintiff's inputs.
repricing_events.if_unfavorable: No hours: back_pay stays a placeholder; price on statutory relief and distress only.

repricing_events.event: First Advantage report or Best Buy adjudication record obtained
repricing_events.if_favorable: Registry-source line: trigger met; raise additional, exemplary, and distress p sharply.
repricing_events.if_unfavorable: Lawful conviction source only: lower everything; consider whether the claim survives.

repricing_events.if_favorable: Denied: public jury case; Best Buy's risk rises; reprice up.
repricing_events.if_unfavorable: Granted with stay: arbitrator-fee meter starts for Best Buy; natural mediation point.

repricing_events.if_favorable: Low interim earnings: back_pay offset small.
repricing_events.if_unfavorable: Substantial interim earnings: back_pay largely offset.
